files.coast_es.json: Spain mainland incl. Gibraltar peninsula and Isla de Tarifa (joined by causeway), west->east, 58 pts, Douglas-Peucker tol 0.006 deg (max deviation ~0.36')
files.coast_ma.json: Morocco Atlantic coast (from 35.6N) -> Cabo Espartel -> Tanger -> Malabata -> Cires -> Ceuta (Almina peninsula spliced in at the Foso de San Felipe canal) -> Cabo Negro -> south edge 35.6N, west->east, 46 pts, tol 0.006 deg
files.coast_es_detail.json: same as coast_es, tol 0.002 deg (179 pts)
files.coast_ma_detail.json: same as coast_ma, tol 0.002 deg (139 pts)

datum: Shifted to the L105 chart datum (ED50 'Datum Europeo (Potsdam)'): OSM WGS84 + 0.08' N and + 0.07' E, as printed on the chart ('situaciones WGS-84 deberan ser desplazadas 0,08 minutos al Norte y 0,07 minutos al Este'). Subtract to get WGS84.
source: OpenStreetMap natural=coastline ways, fetched 2026-10-02 via Overpass API (maps.mail.ru mirror), merged with shapely linemerge, clipped, simplified (Douglas-Peucker).
licence: ODbL 1.0 — attribution required: '© OpenStreetMap contributors' (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Derived database must remain ODbL if redistributed as a database.
caveats: OSM reflects the present coast: Algeciras port (Isla Verde / Campamento extensions), Tanger-Med and Ksar es Srhir ports and Tanger city port differ from the 2007 L105 chart drawing. Visually verified overlay on the chart: open coast matches within the line width.
Simplified lines cut across small harbours and coves.
